description: This file defines the BasketQueryService class which implements the IBasketQueryService interface. It provides a method to asynchronously count total basket items for a specified user from the database using Entity Framework Core.

classes.name: BasketQueryService
classes.description: Service class for querying basket data, specifically counting total items in a basket for a user.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts the total number of items in a user's basket by summing the Quantity of each item.
